Return a Hertwill brand's shipping price lists — each a coverage tag (e.g. "EU") with per origin->destination rates — so you can estimate delivery costs before importing its products. Optionally filter by a 2-letter origin country code. Do NOT use for a brand's marketing assets or profile (use get_brand) or for a single product's shipping coverage (use get_product). Returns {data:[{id, name, description, per_item, shipping_prices:[{origin_iso_code, dest_iso_code, price, ...}]}]}. No auth required.
